_note: Copy to with_encoder/configs/encoders.json (gitignored) and point WITH_ENCODER_WEIGHTS at a directory that already holds the weights. Nothing is downloaded: every adapter loads with local_files_only and the Hugging Face offline flags on. Check with: python with_encoder/encoders/registry.py --check with_encoder/configs/encoders.json

texture._why: The texture-statistics network of Gatys et al. and the backbone family of LPIPS/DISTS, so the baselines and our terms differ in how features are compared, not in which features. relu1_2 (stride 1) is left out: at stride 1 it is close to pixels and costs 64 channels x every pixel.

semantic._why: Material identity for the tile graph and semantic fidelity. ViT-L with registers: register tokens remove the high-norm artefact tokens that would otherwise dominate pooled descriptors. ViT-g is an ablation, not the default (about 4x the cost for a graph).

latent._why: 16-channel, stride-8 autoencoder not used by VOSR, SeedVR or (as far as known) CASR. FLUX.1-schnell is Apache-2.0; the FLUX.1-dev release is non-commercial. Optional: set to null to drop the latent terms.

conflicts._note: method key (exact, or prefix before '_') -> encoder families the method was built on. A latent family listed here removes the latent terms for that method; any other role is flagged and needs a cross-check run with a different encoder for that role. Verify every entry against the method's code before reporting.

_conflict_sources.vosr: github.com/cswry/VOSR README: VOSR-1.4B decodes through the 16-channel Qwen-Image VAE (2D variant), VOSR-0.5B through the SD2.1 VAE or a lightweight decoder; DINOv2 weights ship with the release (torch_cache/), so DINOv2-based terms are flagged for VOSR.
_conflict_sources.seedvr: SeedVR (Wang et al., CVPR 2025) trains its own causal video VAE. Verify against the checkpoint actually used.
_conflict_sources.casr: Unknown which CASR this is (see genet_ablation/PROTOCOL.md). A diffusion CasSR likely decodes through a Stable Diffusion VAE; fill this in once known.

alternatives._note: Encoders for the ablation arms in ABLATION.md. Swap one into 'stack' per run and give the run its own --tag.

semantic_convnext_deep._role_note: non-DINOv2 semantic cross-check: put it in the semantic slot; its maps are relabelled to that role
